resumeText:
Rahul Nair | Kochi, Kerala | rahul.nair.sec@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security), Rajagiri School of Engineering, Kochi (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.2/10

INTERNSHIP
Security Intern, Malabar InfoSec Services, Kochi (Jun 2025 - Jul 2025, 8 weeks)
- Ran Nessus vulnerability scans on 30 lab servers and listed findings by CVSS score for the team lead.
- Checked a client's test web app against the OWASP Top 10 and reported two stored XSS issues.

PROJECTS
- Home network scanner (personal): Wrote a Python script that uses nmap to find open ports on my home network and emails a daily summary.
- Hardened lab server (academic, Network Security course): Configured an Ubuntu Linux server with firewall rules, SSH key login and fail2ban as part of the Network Security course.
- Packet analysis (academic, Computer Networks course): Captured TCP/IP and DNS traffic in Wireshark and explained the three-way handshake in a lab report.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Computer Networks, Cryptography, Network Security, Operating Systems
- Cisco Introduction to Cybersecurity; TryHackMe Pre-Security path

SKILLS
Linux, Python, Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite Community, Nessus, Splunk (basics), Networking

ACTIVITIES
- Conducted a cyber hygiene workshop for 80 first-year students on phishing and passwords
- CTF team member, college cyber club
